That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. You'll work daily with product, engineering, AI evaluation and solution engineering teams: close enough to the technology to explain how it works, and close enough to the market to explain why it matters. Healthcare has broadly started piloting agentic AI, but few organizations have scaled it. Your work helps close that gap. We are about 200 people across the US, UK, Europe and Latin America, and we are still growing. Every hire, promotion and comp cycle depends on a pay system that leaders trust and employees understand. Our rewards foundation is taking shape. We benchmark with Pave, apply a consistent pay convention to new offers and are building company-wide leveling. Now we need someone to raise the bar and turn it into a system that scales, with bands leaders trust, cycles that land on time and equity guidelines that work across countries. You will work directly with the VP, People and the CFO, and you will help bring comp decisions to our board's compensation committee. This is a builder seat with real ownership of how rewards work at NetBox Labs. Who this is for You have taken comp from a spreadsheet to a system before, and you want to do it again with more ownership. You know when a band needs to be exact and when it needs to ship. When a request would break the system, you say no clearly and bring an alternative. You already use AI in your modeling and analysis, and you would rather automate a cycle than run it by hand twice. What you will own Comp structure and philosophy Own salary bands by level and function, built on our leveling framework and Pave market data Shape our comp philosophy, including market positioning, jobs.title: Crux - Video and Audio QA - German (Germany)
jobs.description: Overview We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks. You will perform quality checks on initial ratings produced by evaluators—validating user intent assessment, query annotation, text classification, and multimedia (video, image, audio) reviews for relevance, accuracy, and guideline adherence. The ideal candidate combines strong language skills with sharp analytical judgment, excellent documentation and feedback skills, and familiarity with short-form video culture What you will do Audit samples of initial ratings for relevance, intent alignment, taxonomy compliance, and linguistic quality. Re-rate items (double-scoring) to verify labels; resolve discrepancies and document decisions. Perform linguistic quality checks (grammar, tone, clarity, local relevance) and media comprehension reviews. Classify and track errors using an agreed error taxonomy; surface trends and edge cases. Provide clear, actionable feedback to evaluators; contribute to guideline clarifications and updates. Participate in and lead calibration sessions to drive inter-rater agreement. Track and report QC metrics (e.g., agreement rates, accuracy, error trends) and meet QC SLAs. Triage escalations, handle ambiguous cases, and ensure data integrity and compliance. Use internal tools to complete, track, and submit QC tasks accurately. Project Details Engagement Type: Freelance Rate: USD 28/hour Estimated Hours: 15-30 hours/week Requirement English at C1 level or higher. Native or near-native speaker level in German language with strong reading, writing, and listening comprehension. Excellent grammar, writing, and proofreading skills. Strong video and image comprehension; good hearing ability for audio tasks. Solid understanding of search engines, user intent, and web content. High attention to detail, consistency, and guideline adherence. Ability to deliver clear written feedback and rationale. Preferred qualifications Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation. Familiarity with short dramas and local short-drama culture/platforms. Experience with calibrations, sampling, scorecards, and root-cause analysis. Comfortable working with productivity and quality targets; proficient with spreadsheets/QA tools. Background in linguistics, communications, media studies, information science, or related field. Compensation Additional Information

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, OS Integration
jobs.description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About the OS Integration team: The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. About the role: As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion. What you’ll do: Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users. Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox. Collaborate with experienced software engineers. Perform code reviews and provide technical direction. Work with a geographically-distributed development team. Interact with teams throughout the organization. What you’ll bring: 7+ years of overall software engineering experience. Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++. Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64. Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS. Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset. Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment. Commitment to our values: Welcoming differences Being relationship-minded Practicing responsible participation Having grit Bonus Points for experience with: Enterprise DLP development or deployment Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus pla

Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. What You’ll Do Perform site walkdowns to verify installed electrical systems against approved designs, single-line diagrams, specifications, submittals, and Lambda standards. Validate equipment ratings, protection settings, phasing, grounding and bonding, terminations, labeling, redundancy, and electrical failure domains. Identify installation deficiencies, design conflicts, and operational risks; document punch-list items and drive them through closure. Review construction test results and witness factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, functional testing, and integrated systems testing. Develop and review energization plans, MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, switching procedures, and electrical safety controls. Support initial energization and troubleshoot issues involving substations, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, busway, PDUs, RPPs, and rack-level distribution. Coordinate with design engineers, engineering partners, utilities, general contractors, electrical trades, equipment manufacturers, commissioning agents, operations, and HPC deployment teams. Confirm that electrical capacity, voltage, redundancy, monitoring, and protection are ready before IT equipment is energized. Validate as-built documentation, equipment settings, test reports, commissioning records, and turnover packages before operational handoff. Capture field lessons and incorporate them into Lambda’s design standards, commissioning requirements, and site-validation playbooks. Mentor other engineers and provide senior technical leadership during high-risk energization and bring-up activities. You Have significant experience delivering, commissioning, or operating electrical systems in data centers, mission-critical facilities, utilities, or large industrial environments. Understand both medium- and low-voltage distribution, including transformers, switchgear, protective relays, generators, UPS systems, busway, grounding, and rack-level power. Can interpret single-line diagrams, equipment submittals, protection studies, relay settings, test reports, and construction documentation. Have hands-on experience with site inspections, electrical testing, energization, commissioning, or operational turnover. Understand electrical safety, lockout/tagout, energized work controls, and applicable NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, and NETA requirements. Can distinguish between cosmetic deficiencies and conditions that create material safety, reliability, or operational risk. Are comfortable making decisions in the field, escalating critical issues, and coordinating corrective work under schedule pressure. Communicate clearly with construction teams, engineers, vendors, operators, and senior stakeholders. Are willing to travel extensively and spend extended periods at active construction and commissioning sites. Hold a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience commissioning hyperscale, colocation, HPC, or AI data centers. Experience supporting first energization and initial IT-load or GPU-cluster bring-up. Familiarity with Level 1–5 commiss

You’re the tip of the spear, the person who makes the first deployment work, no matter what it takes; the adventurer, the explorer, the builder. Edge-First Engineering: Deploy and operate computer vision systems on edge hardware in physical environments. Where conditions are unpredictable and connectivity is unreliable. jobs.description: Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role. Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day. About MetaMask MetaMask is building a future where users can unlock the full product stack through a single, seamless identity experience, enabling access to all features with trust, safety, and minimal friction. Today, identity verification is fragmented across several product and onboarding experiences. Users are repeatedly asked to verify themselves across different services, creating unnecessary friction, inconsistent outcomes, and degraded trust. Universal KYC (UKYC) is a new initiative to solve this problem by creating a single, reusable identity layer across MetaMask. At the centre of this is MetaMask Passport , a product designed to enable users to verify once and unlock multiple experiences across the MetaMask ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of platform and product experience . You will define the primitives, standards, and user journeys that make identity verification seamless, privacy-conscious, and globally compliant. What you’ll do You will own the vision and roadmap for Universal KYC and MetaMask Passport, defining how a reusable identity layer unlocks the broader MetaMask product stack. You will build the underlying identity platform, creating scalable verification primitives and standards that can be adopted across products. In parallel, you will design a seamless, low-friction KYC experience that reduces time-to-first-transaction while maintaining compliance integrity. You will drive adoption across MetaMask by partnering closely with internal teams to integrate a consistent identity layer, while balancing privacy, trust, and global regulatory requirements. Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes. What we are looking for: Proven experience building or scaling identity verification (IDV), KYC, or onboarding products Strong background in fintech , ideally with exposure to Web3 Hands-on experience working with identity verification providers (IDV vendors) such as Sumsub, Veriff, Onfido, Persona, or Stripe Identity Familiarity with compliance workflows , including KYC, KYB, and customer due diligence (CDD) processes Track record of delivering platform products adopted across multiple teams Ability to operate across both technical systems and user experience What Success looks like: Increased KYC completion rates and reduced onboarding friction Reduced time-to-first-transaction across KYC-gated flows Increased reuse of verified identity across products Improved transaction success rate through consistent verification outcomes Strong user trust with minimal friction and compliant execution Attributes that will make you stand out First-principles thinker with strong product judgment Deep user empathy with a focus on reducing friction and cognitive load Strong

We use AI to reduce the manual effort behind preconstruction engineering by automating document understanding, consistency checks, and repetitive workflow steps across major disciplines. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.
